headline: A Tokyo conference on physical AI, attended by Prime Minister Takaichi, heard a business leader warn that Japan is far behind in robotics.
score_reason: Headline claims a national 10 million robot goal that the text does not show; the event is from 15 Sep; cut by 2.
importance_line: Japan's workers and robot makers are the audience for this warning, but the quoted view is one executive's opinion and the reported text does not confirm any government target.
summary: BigGo Finance reports on a physical AI conference held in Tokyo on 15 Sep 2026, attended by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and other ministers, where GMO Internet Group founder Masatoshi Kumagai said Japan is "laps behind" in AI and robotics and should build a domestic humanoid industry as its workforce shrinks. The text we read does not show the 10 million robot goal named in the headline, so that figure remains unconfirmed; the event is from 15 Sep 2026.
notes: Headline's '10 million AI robots' target not found in article text; no Takaichi quote. Treat the goal as unverified. Article also drifts into investment advice (not carried).
